_comment: Excludes for scripts/check-doc-links.ts (issue #140). Each entry is a regular expression matched against the raw link target, with the reason it is excluded. Keep this list short: an exclude is a known-broken or unverifiable link, not a way to silence a typo. Remove an entry as soon as its reason no longer holds.

ignore.reason: docs/deprecations.md links ahead to docs/design-principles.md, which is tracked as pending in #162 (the link is annotated as such in place). Remove this entry when #162 lands.
Local development URLs (e.g. a local RPC or dashboard) are examples, not resources the docs depend on; they are unreachable from CI by design.

npmjs.com answers automated HEAD/GET requests with HTTP 403 (bot protection), so these links can never pass from CI. The package itself is verified by docs/releasing.md's post-publish checks against the registry API instead.
